title: Concept: Response body embeds a presigned object-storage URL
description: A presigned URL is a bearer credential with an expiry. Written into HTML it is copied into screenshots, support tickets and page caches, and until it expires anyone who holds the string can read the object whatever the application otherwise enforces.
applicability: Responses generated by an application that stores files in S3-compatible or Azure storage.
risk: The signature grants read access to the object for anyone who obtains the page, bypassing every authorisation check the application performs.
